sustainable

能够长期维持，而不持续耗尽所需资源；也常用于谈环境上可持续的做法。

a sustainable approach / transport system / level of spending；be sustainable in the long run；financially / environmentally sustainable。

And more farmers in poor countries will have the money and the incentive to manage their land in ways that are sustainable in the long run.

原文完整句，来自现有资料正文；只合并排版换行，未引用题干或答案。

原文：

Governments, farming and environmental management

日常语境例句

A shorter daily study routine may be more sustainable than occasional five-hour sessions.

较短的每日学习安排，可能比偶尔一次学五小时更容易长期维持。

不只等于环保，也不等于目前有效。effective 问能否产生效果，sustainable 问能否持续维持，两者需要不同证据。
